messageSchema.description: Public SBE WebSocket contract for low-latency trading commands, acknowledgements, and authenticated private events

composite.name: messageHeader
composite.description: Eight-byte SBE header that prefixes every WebSocket binary message

type.name: blockLength
type.description: Encoded length in bytes of the message fixed block, excluding this header and variable-length data

type.name: templateId
type.description: Message template identifier used to select the payload type

type.name: schemaId
type.description: Schema identifier; must equal 7 for this contract

type.name: version
type.description: Schema version used by the sender to encode the message

composite.name: varDataEncoding
composite.description: Length-prefixed byte sequence used for variable-length message data

type.name: length
type.description: Number of payload bytes that immediately follow this length prefix

type.name: varData
type.description: Payload bytes interpreted according to the containing data field

enum.name: CommandType
enum.description: Client command carried in a WebSocket binary message

validValue.name: PING
validValue.description: Tests session liveness without submitting a trading command

validValue.name: CREATE_ORDER
validValue.description: Submits one new order for admission

validValue.name: CANCEL_ORDER
validValue.description: Requests cancellation of one order

validValue.name: MODIFY_ORDER
validValue.description: Requests changes to one existing order

validValue.name: CANCEL_ALL_ORDERS
validValue.description: Requests cancellation of all matching open orders in the authenticated account scope

validValue.name: SUBSCRIBE
validValue.description: Replaces the private event-channel subscription for the connection

enum.name: Side
enum.description: Direction of an order or account execution

validValue.name: BUY
validValue.description: Buy the base asset using the quote asset

validValue.name: SELL
validValue.description: Sell the base asset for the quote asset

enum.name: OrderType
enum.description: Price behavior requested for an order

validValue.name: LIMIT
validValue.description: Executes only at the specified limit price or better

validValue.name: MARKET
validValue.description: Executes immediately against available liquidity subject to price protection

enum.name: TimeInForce
enum.description: Policy controlling how long an order may remain active and whether partial execution is allowed

validValue.name: GTC
validValue.description: Good-til-canceled; unexecuted quantity may remain active until canceled

validValue.name: IOC
validValue.description: Immediate-or-cancel; executes available quantity immediately and cancels any remainder

validValue.name: FOK
validValue.description: Fill-or-kill; executes the entire quantity immediately or cancels without execution

enum.name: FeeAsset
enum.description: Asset in which order fees are charged; SELL orders must use QUOTE

validValue.name: QUOTE
validValue.description: Charge fees in the quote asset

validValue.name: BASE
validValue.description: BUY-only option that deducts fees from the received base asset

enum.name: OrderSizingKind
enum.description: Required method used to size a new order

validValue.name: BASE_QUANTITY
validValue.description: Size the order by an exact gross base-asset quantity

validValue.name: MAX_QUOTE_DEBIT
validValue.description: Size an eligible BUY order by a hard all-in quote-asset debit limit

validValue.name: EXPIRE_MAKER
validValue.description: Cancel the resting order when it would trade against the same account

validValue.name: EXPIRE_TAKER
validValue.description: Cancel the incoming order when it would trade against the same account

validValue.name: EXPIRE_BOTH
validValue.description: Cancel both orders when they would trade against the same account

enum.name: ModifyBehavior
enum.description: Policy controlling whether modification may retain or replace the existing order

validValue.name: AMEND_OR_REPLACE
validValue.description: Amend in place when possible; otherwise cancel and replace the order

validValue.name: AMEND_ONLY
validValue.description: Amend in place and reject changes that require replacement

validValue.name: REPLACE_ONLY
validValue.description: Always cancel the existing order and create a replacement

enum.name: RejectCode
enum.description: Stable machine-readable rejection reason; shared order-domain values use the same numbers as the Orders API

validValue.name: BAD_REQUEST
validValue.description: The message could not be decoded or was structurally invalid

validValue.name: INVALID_ARGUMENT
validValue.description: One or more request fields or field combinations were invalid

validValue.name: INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS
validValue.description: The account did not have enough available balance for the order

validValue.name: UNKNOWN_SYMBOL
validValue.description: The requested trading pair was unknown

validValue.name: BAD_PRICE
validValue.description: The requested price was invalid

validValue.name: BAD_QTY
validValue.description: The requested quantity was invalid

validValue.name: MIN_NOTIONAL
validValue.description: The order notional was below the pair minimum

validValue.name: QTY_STEP_SIZE
validValue.description: The quantity did not align with the pair step size

validValue.name: CONFLICT_DUPLICATE_CLIENT_ORDER_ID
validValue.description: The client order identifier was already used for a different active order

validValue.name: UNAVAILABLE
validValue.description: A required trading capability was temporarily unavailable

validValue.name: UNAUTHENTICATED
validValue.description: The caller was not authenticated

validValue.name: PERMISSION_DENIED
validValue.description: The authenticated caller was not allowed to perform the command

validValue.name: NOT_FOUND
validValue.description: The requested order or resource was not found

validValue.name: UPSTREAM_ERROR
validValue.description: A required dependency rejected or failed the command

validValue.name: FEE_ASSET_NOT_ALLOWED
validValue.description: The requested fee asset was not allowed for the order

validValue.name: PAIR_DISABLED
validValue.description: The trading pair was disabled

validValue.name: ORDER_UNKNOWN
validValue.description: The requested order was unknown in the authenticated account scope

validValue.name: INTERNAL_ERROR
validValue.description: The command failed because of an unexpected server error

validValue.name: POLICY_MARKET_DENY
validValue.description: The account policy did not allow trading on the requested pair

validValue.name: POLICY_MAX_NOTIONAL
validValue.description: The order exceeded the account policy maximum notional

validValue.name: POLICY_TRADING_HALTED
validValue.description: Trading was halted for the authenticated account scope

validValue.name: POLICY_SPOT_TRADE_DENY
validValue.description: The account policy did not allow spot trading

validValue.name: API_KEY_POLICY_REQUIRED
validValue.description: The API key required an attached trading policy

validValue.name: API_KEY_UNKNOWN
validValue.description: The API key could not be resolved

validValue.name: API_KEY_MARKET_DENY
validValue.description: The API key policy did not allow trading on the requested pair

validValue.name: PRICE_TICK_SIZE
validValue.description: The price did not align with the pair tick size

validValue.name: MIN_QTY
validValue.description: The quantity was below the pair minimum

validValue.name: POLICY_MAX_OPEN_ORDERS
validValue.description: The account reached its policy limit for open orders

validValue.name: MODIFICATION_REQUIRES_REPLACE
validValue.description: The requested modification required replacement but replacement was not allowed

validValue.name: CONFLICT_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE
validValue.description: An idempotency key was reused with a different payload

validValue.name: MARKET_PRICE_UNAVAILABLE
validValue.description: No reference price was available to admit the market order

validValue.name: TRIGGER_PRICE_INVALID
validValue.description: The trigger price was invalid for the requested order

validValue.name: TRIGGER_PRICE_SOURCE_UNSUPPORTED
validValue.description: The requested trigger price source was unsupported

validValue.name: TRAILING_DISTANCE_INVALID
validValue.description: The trailing-stop distance was invalid

validValue.name: PAIR_NOT_LISTED_YET
validValue.description: The trading pair was known but not yet listed

validValue.name: PAIR_DELISTED
validValue.description: The trading pair was delisted

validValue.name: PAIR_CANCEL_ONLY
validValue.description: The trading pair accepted cancellations but not new or replacement orders

validValue.name: PAIR_POST_ONLY
validValue.description: The trading pair required post-only order placement

validValue.name: PAIR_REDUCE_ONLY
validValue.description: The trading pair did not accept new spot exposure

validValue.name: RISK_LIMIT
validValue.description: An account-level risk limit was exceeded

validValue.name: MARKET_HALTED
validValue.description: The market was halted

validValue.name: ACCOUNT_UNKNOWN
validValue.description: The authenticated account could not be resolved

validValue.name: POST_ONLY_CROSS
validValue.description: A post-only order would have immediately crossed the book

validValue.name: REDUCE_ONLY_BLOCKED
validValue.description: Reduce-only policy blocked the order

validValue.name: PRICE_BAND_VIOLATION
validValue.description: The order violated the market price band

validValue.name: MARKET_CAP_VIOLATION
validValue.description: The order violated the market-cap guard

validValue.name: EMPTY_BOOK
validValue.description: The market order could not execute because the book was empty

validValue.name: FOK_INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY
validValue.description: The fill-or-kill order lacked sufficient immediate liquidity

validValue.name: ORDER_ALREADY_TERMINAL
validValue.description: The client order identifier referred to an order already in a terminal state

validValue.name: STALE_QUOTE
validValue.description: The client reference price was stale under the server drift policy

validValue.name: VALIDATION_ERROR
validValue.description: The request failed structural or cross-field validation

validValue.name: OVERLOADED
validValue.description: The connection or trading service reached bounded admission capacity

validValue.name: MAX_QUOTE_DEBIT_TOO_SMALL
validValue.description: The quote debit limit could not resolve one valid step-aligned base quantity

validValue.name: RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED
validValue.description: The authenticated account exhausted the applicable trading quota

validValue.name: SEQUENCE_OUT_OF_ORDER
validValue.description: The client sequence did not equal the next expected sequence for this connection

enum.name: LiquidityRole
enum.description: Liquidity role of the authenticated account's order in an execution

validValue.name: MAKER
validValue.description: The order was resting and provided liquidity

validValue.name: TAKER
validValue.description: The order was incoming and removed liquidity

enum.name: SettlementStatus
enum.description: Financial finality of an execution notification

validValue.name: PENDING
validValue.description: The execution occurred but financial settlement is not yet final; fee amounts are not yet available

validValue.name: SETTLED
validValue.description: Financial settlement completed and the execution is available from durable trade history

enum.name: OrderStatus
enum.description: Current lifecycle state of an order

validValue.name: PENDING
validValue.description: Accepted for processing but not yet active for execution

validValue.name: PENDING_CANCEL
validValue.description: Cancellation requested; the order may execute until cancellation completes

validValue.name: PENDING_REPLACE
validValue.description: Replacement requested; the replacement is not yet active for execution

validValue.name: WORKING
validValue.description: Active and eligible to rest or execute

validValue.name: FILLED
validValue.description: Fully executed with no remaining quantity

validValue.name: CANCELED
validValue.description: Canceled with no remaining active quantity

validValue.name: REJECTED
validValue.description: Rejected before becoming active

set.name: EventChannels
set.description: Private event channels enabled for this authenticated connection

choice.name: executions
choice.description: Receive private execution notifications for the authenticated account scope

choice.name: orders
choice.description: Receive private order lifecycle notifications for the authenticated account scope

enum.name: RateLimitOperation
enum.description: Trading operation whose rate limit rejected the command

validValue.name: CREATE_ORDER
validValue.description: Single-order placement operation

validValue.name: CANCEL_ORDER
validValue.description: Single-order cancellation operation

validValue.name: MODIFY_ORDER
validValue.description: Single-order modification operation

validValue.name: CANCEL_ALL_ORDERS
validValue.description: Bulk cancellation operation

enum.name: RateLimitPolicyClass
enum.description: Quota family used for a rate-limit decision

validValue.name: TRADING_PLACE
validValue.description: Quota shared by order placement and modification operations

validValue.name: TRADING_CANCEL
validValue.description: Quota shared by order cancellation operations

enum.name: RateLimitScope
enum.description: Caller dimension that owns exhausted capacity

validValue.name: ACCOUNT
validValue.description: Quota capacity is shared by the authenticated account

enum.name: RateLimitRefillModel
enum.description: How exhausted quota capacity becomes available again

validValue.name: CONTINUOUS
validValue.description: Capacity replenishes continuously over time

choice.name: postOnly
choice.description: Reject the order rather than execute immediately; valid only for GTC limit orders

message.name: Ping
message.description: Tests connection liveness without submitting a trading command

field.name: seq
field.description: Required per-connection client sequence number; the first admitted message is 1 and each subsequently admitted message increments by exactly 1

field.name: correlationId
field.description: Client-chosen correlation token copied unchanged into the corresponding Pong

data.name: payload
data.description: Opaque bytes copied unchanged into the corresponding Pong

message.name: CreateOrder
message.description: Submits one order for admission; an acknowledgement does not imply that the order is active or executed

field.name: seq
field.description: Required per-connection client sequence number; the first admitted message is 1 and each subsequently admitted message increments by exactly 1

field.name: correlationId
field.description: Client-chosen correlation token copied unchanged into the corresponding acknowledgement or rejection

field.name: symbolId
field.description: Stable numeric trading-pair identifier returned by GetSpotConfig; must be greater than zero

field.name: side
field.description: Required direction of the order

field.name: orderType
field.description: Required price behavior of the order

field.name: timeInForce
field.description: Required lifetime and fill policy; MARKET orders require IOC

field.name: baseQtyScaled
field.description: Exact gross base-asset quantity scaled by the pair's base_quantity_scale from GetSpotConfig; required and positive for BASE_QUANTITY sizing, otherwise null

field.name: priceTicks
field.description: Limit price in quote units scaled by 1e6; required and positive for LIMIT orders, null for MARKET orders

field.name: flags
field.description: Bitset of requested order behaviors; zero enables no optional behaviors

field.name: feeAsset
field.description: Required asset in which fees are charged; SELL orders must use QUOTE

field.name: stpMode
field.description: Self-trade prevention mode; null defaults to EXPIRE_MAKER

field.name: marketClientRefPriceTicks
field.description: Optional client reference price for MARKET price protection in quote units scaled by 1e6; null uses server reference pricing

field.name: marketMaxSlippageTicks
field.description: Optional positive MARKET slippage limit as a price delta in 1e-6 quote-unit ticks; null uses the pair default and is mutually exclusive with marketMaxSlippageBps

field.name: marketMaxSlippageBps
field.description: Optional MARKET slippage limit from 1 to 10000 basis points, where 1 basis point is 0.01 percent; null uses the pair default and is mutually exclusive with marketMaxSlippageTicks

field.name: sizingKind
field.description: Required sizing method that selects exactly one of baseQtyScaled or maxQuoteDebitScaled

field.name: maxQuoteDebitScaled
field.description: Hard all-in quote-asset debit limit scaled by the pair's quote_quantity_scale from GetSpotConfig; required and positive for MAX_QUOTE_DEBIT sizing, valid only for BUY MARKET IOC and BUY LIMIT IOC, otherwise null

data.name: clientOrderId
data.description: Required client-generated idempotency key for WebSocket order placement; 1 to 36 ASCII characters using letters, digits, period, underscore, colon, slash, or hyphen

message.name: CancelOrder
message.description: Requests cancellation of one order identified by orderId or clientOrderId

field.name: seq
field.description: Required per-connection client sequence number; the first admitted message is 1 and each subsequently admitted message increments by exactly 1

field.name: correlationId
field.description: Client-chosen correlation token copied unchanged into the corresponding acknowledgement or rejection

field.name: orderId
field.description: Public order identifier; exactly one of orderId or clientOrderId is required, and this field is zero when clientOrderId is used

field.name: symbolId
field.description: Optional stable numeric trading-pair identifier returned by GetSpotConfig; zero lets the service resolve the pair from the order key

data.name: clientOrderId
data.description: Client-generated order identifier scoped to the authenticated account; exactly one of orderId or clientOrderId is required, and this value is empty when orderId is used

message.name: ModifyOrder
message.description: Requests a quantity, price, or client identifier change to one existing order

field.name: seq
field.description: Required per-connection client sequence number; the first admitted message is 1 and each subsequently admitted message increments by exactly 1

field.name: correlationId
field.description: Client-chosen correlation token copied unchanged into the corresponding acknowledgement or rejection

field.name: orderId
field.description: Public identifier of the order to modify; exactly one of orderId or clientOrderId is required, and this field is zero when clientOrderId is used

field.name: symbolId
field.description: Optional stable numeric trading-pair identifier returned by GetSpotConfig; zero lets the service resolve the pair from the order key

field.name: newQtyScaled
field.description: Optional positive target total gross base-asset quantity after modification, scaled by the pair's base_quantity_scale from GetSpotConfig; null leaves quantity unchanged

field.name: priceTicks
field.description: Optional positive target limit price after modification in quote units scaled by 1e6; null leaves price unchanged

field.name: behavior
field.description: Required modification policy; zero is invalid

data.name: clientOrderId
data.description: Client-generated identifier of the order to modify; exactly one of orderId or clientOrderId is required, and this value is empty when orderId is used

data.name: newClientOrderId
data.description: Optional replacement client order identifier; empty leaves the identifier unchanged, and a non-empty value must use 1 to 36 supported ASCII characters

message.name: CancelAllOrders
message.description: Cancel open orders for an account, optionally scoped by symbol and side

field.name: seq
field.description: Required per-connection client sequence number; the first admitted message is 1 and each subsequently admitted message increments by exactly 1

field.name: correlationId
field.description: Client-chosen correlation token copied unchanged into the corresponding acknowledgement or rejection

field.name: symbolId
field.description: Stable numeric trading-pair identifier returned by GetSpotConfig; zero matches all trading pairs

field.name: side
field.description: Order-side filter; null matches both BUY and SELL orders

field.name: dryRun
field.description: Boolean encoded as 0 or 1; 1 returns the matched order count without requesting cancellations, while 0 requests cancellation

message.name: Subscribe
message.description: Replace the private event-channel subscription for this authenticated connection

field.name: seq
field.description: Required per-connection client sequence number; the first admitted message is 1 and each subsequently admitted message increments by exactly 1

field.name: correlationId
field.description: Client-chosen correlation token copied unchanged into the corresponding SubscriptionAck or rejection

field.name: channels
field.description: Complete desired channel bitset that replaces the previous subscription; zero unsubscribes from all private events

message.name: CommandAck
message.description: Confirms that a trading command was accepted; later order and execution events report lifecycle outcomes

field.name: seq
field.description: Client sequence number copied from the accepted command

field.name: correlationId
field.description: Client correlation token copied from the accepted command

field.name: commandType
field.description: Type of command that was accepted

field.name: orderId
field.description: Public order identifier returned for CREATE_ORDER, CANCEL_ORDER, or MODIFY_ORDER; zero when the command has no single-order result

field.name: symbolId
field.description: Stable numeric trading-pair identifier associated with the result; zero when the command was not scoped to one pair

field.name: tsNs
field.description: Command acceptance timestamp in nanoseconds since the Unix epoch, UTC

field.name: matchedOrders
field.description: For CANCEL_ALL_ORDERS, number of open orders matching the requested filters; zero for other commands or when none matched

field.name: submittedCancels
field.description: For non-dry-run CANCEL_ALL_ORDERS, number of cancellation requests accepted for processing; zero otherwise

field.name: failedCancels
field.description: For non-dry-run CANCEL_ALL_ORDERS, number of matching orders whose cancellation could not be submitted; zero otherwise

field.name: resolvedBaseQtyScaled
field.description: For CREATE_ORDER, gross base-asset quantity resolved for execution and scaled by the pair's base_quantity_scale from GetSpotConfig; null for other commands

field.name: submittedMaxQuoteDebitScaled
field.description: For CREATE_ORDER using MAX_QUOTE_DEBIT sizing, the submitted hard all-in quote-asset debit limit scaled by the pair's quote_quantity_scale from GetSpotConfig; null otherwise

message.name: CommandReject
message.description: Reports a command-level failure without closing the connection

field.name: seq
field.description: Client sequence number copied from the rejected command when decodable; zero when unavailable

field.name: correlationId
field.description: Client correlation token copied from the rejected command when decodable; zero when unavailable

field.name: code
field.description: Stable machine-readable reason for the rejection

field.name: tsNs
field.description: Rejection timestamp in nanoseconds since the Unix epoch, UTC

field.name: rateLimitWeight
field.description: Maximum weighted capacity of the applicable quota; zero when the rejection is not rate-limit related

field.name: rateLimitRemaining
field.description: Weighted capacity remaining after the decision; null when the rejection is not rate-limit related

field.name: rateLimitRetryAfterNs
field.description: Minimum delay in nanoseconds before retrying the rate-limited operation; zero when no delay applies

field.name: rateLimitPolicyVersion
field.description: Version of the quota policy used for the decision; zero when the rejection is not rate-limit related

field.name: rateLimitOperation
field.description: Trading operation whose quota was exhausted; null when the rejection is not rate-limit related

field.name: rateLimitPolicyClass
field.description: Quota family used for the decision; null when the rejection is not rate-limit related

field.name: rateLimitScope
field.description: Authenticated caller scope that owns the exhausted capacity; null when the rejection is not rate-limit related

field.name: rateLimitRefillModel
field.description: Method by which the exhausted capacity replenishes; null when the rejection is not rate-limit related

data.name: detail
data.description: UTF-8 diagnostic text safe to display or log; clients must branch on code rather than this text

field.name: seq
field.description: Client sequence number copied from the Ping

field.name: correlationId
field.description: Client correlation token copied from the Ping

data.name: payload
data.description: Opaque bytes copied unchanged from the Ping payload

message.name: SubscriptionAck
message.description: Confirms the complete private event-channel subscription for this connection

field.name: seq
field.description: Client sequence number copied from the Subscribe command

field.name: correlationId
field.description: Client correlation token copied from the Subscribe command

field.name: channels
field.description: Complete private event-channel bitset now active for the connection; zero means no private events are subscribed

field.name: tsNs
field.description: Subscription update timestamp in nanoseconds since the Unix epoch, UTC

message.name: ExecutionEvent
message.description: Private low-latency execution notification for one order in the authenticated account scope; the same execution may be sent first as PENDING and later as SETTLED

field.name: symbolId
field.description: Stable numeric trading-pair identifier returned by GetSpotConfig

field.name: matchId
field.description: Trade identifier monotonic within one trading pair; use with symbolId and orderId to de-duplicate PENDING and SETTLED notifications

field.name: matchSeq
field.description: Execution sequence monotonic within one trading pair; gaps are expected because this private feed includes only the authenticated account's executions

field.name: orderId
field.description: Public identifier of the authenticated account's order that received this fill

field.name: side
field.description: Side of the authenticated account's order

field.name: liquidityRole
field.description: Whether the authenticated account's order provided or removed liquidity

field.name: feeAsset
field.description: Asset selected for fees; this message does not include the fee amount, which is available from durable trade history after settlement

field.name: settlementStatus
field.description: Whether financial settlement for this execution is pending or complete

field.name: fillQtyScaled
field.description: Executed base-asset quantity for this fill, scaled by the pair's base_quantity_scale from GetSpotConfig

field.name: fillPriceTicks
field.description: Execution price in quote units scaled by 1e6

field.name: remainingQtyScaled
field.description: Order quantity remaining immediately after this execution, scaled by the pair's base_quantity_scale from GetSpotConfig; null on SETTLED notifications

field.name: matchTsNs
field.description: Execution timestamp in nanoseconds since the Unix epoch, UTC

field.name: gatewayTsNs
field.description: Timestamp when this WebSocket message was encoded, in nanoseconds since the Unix epoch, UTC; subtract matchTsNs to estimate server-side delivery latency

message.name: OrderEvent
message.description: Private authoritative order lifecycle transition for one order in the authenticated account scope

field.name: symbolId
field.description: Stable numeric trading-pair identifier returned by GetSpotConfig

field.name: orderId
field.description: Public identifier of the authenticated account's order

field.name: version
field.description: Per-order state version starting at 1 and increasing with each published transition; ignore duplicate or older versions and recover current state through the Orders API after a gap

field.name: status
field.description: Lifecycle state after this transition; PENDING_REPLACE is not active liquidity

field.name: remainingQtyScaled
field.description: Unexecuted base-asset quantity after this transition, scaled by the pair's base_quantity_scale from GetSpotConfig; zero for terminal states

field.name: cumulativeQtyScaled
field.description: Total base-asset quantity executed by this order through this transition, scaled by the pair's base_quantity_scale from GetSpotConfig

field.name: reasonCode
field.description: Stable public cancellation or rejection reason code for CANCELED and REJECTED states; zero when no terminal reason applies

field.name: eventTsNs
field.description: Order state-transition timestamp in nanoseconds since the Unix epoch, UTC

field.name: gatewayTsNs
field.description: Timestamp when this WebSocket message was encoded, in nanoseconds since the Unix epoch, UTC; subtract eventTsNs to estimate server-side delivery latency
